title: Profissional Back-End Java
description:
Código da vaga:56155


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 31 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 3 mil funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

Conhecimento em desenvolvimento Java e Kotlin

- Experiência prática com AWS (ECS, S3, CloudFront, Lambda, API Gateway, EC2, Load Balancer, CloudFormation, Autoscalling e outros serviços);

- Experiêcia com Datadog;

- Experiência com Testes Unitários, Testes de Performance e Testes E2E;

- Conhecimentos avançados em Git/Github;

- Experiência com práticas DevOps e CI/CD


CLT, salário a combinar + benefícios.


- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Dados - Especialista
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições

- Realizar análise de dados e modelagem de dados para suportar a tomada de decisão da empresa

- Trabalhar com Big Data para extrair insights e gerar relatórios

- Colaborar em equipe para desenvolver soluções e projetos relacionados a dados

- Comunicar de forma eficaz os resultados das análises realizadas

- Ser proativo na identificação de oportunidades de melhoria e inovação

- Utilizar pensamento analítico e habilidades de resolução de problemas para enfrentar desafios do dia a dia

- Habilidade de trabalho em equipe

- Excelente comunicação

- Proatividade

- Pensamento analítico

- Capacidade de resolver problemas de forma eficaz



Requisitos e qualificações

- Graduação em áreas correlatadas à TI

- Pós-graduação em dados é um diferencial

- Experiência em SQL, Python

- Experiência em GCP (Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Firestore, BigQuery)

- Experiência em pipelines de ingestão de dados como Airflow e Airbyte

- Experiência sólida em dbt (modelagem, macros, documentações e testes)

- Diferencial: Conhecimento em LLM (Vertex AI, Antropic, Azure OpenAI, etc..)

- Diferencial: Experiência em RAGs e DAGs para criação de pipelines de produtos de dados

- Diferencial: Experiência em banco de dados vetoriais e grafos (Neo4J, pgvector, ElasticSearch, etc..)


Informações adicionais

O que você pode esperar da gente?

  • Participação nos lucros: resultados com comemoração fazem parte do jeito Cogna.
  • Vale-refeição ou alimentação: num cartão de benefícios flexível.
  • Assistência médica: um abrangente plano de saúde, com inclusão de dependentes e coparticipação.
  • Assistência odontológica: está disponível para manter seu sorriso.


Mas espera, ainda tem mais!

  • Bolsas de estudo de graduação e pós graduação: nossas unidades de ensino para que você e seus dependentes (cônjuge e filhos).
  • Day off no aniversário: você poderá escolher um dia para relaxar e celebrar.
  • Convênio SESC: abre as portas para as inúmeras oportunidades de melhora na qualidade de vida.
  • Convênio farmácia Univers: descontos numa variedade de medicamentos.
  • Universidade corporativa: diversas trilhas e cursos gratuitos na nossa universidade corporativa para você seguir evoluindo com a gente.
  • Descontos em livros: para você adquirir os melhores títulos em nossas editoras.
  • Wellhub (Gympass): para que você possa se movimentar no seu dia a dia.
  • Programa Ninho: Um programa dedicado às nossas famílias que estão aguardando um novo bebê.
  • Valoriza - Programa de Recrutamento Interno: Para impulsionar sua carreira por meio de oportunidades internas.

Somos a SEIDOR, multinacional de tecnologia e inovação, que oferece um portfólio completo de soluções e serviços para promover a competitividade e a transformação das organizações. São mais de 40 anos acreditando na tecnologia , com 85 escritórios e uma equipe de mais de 7.500 profissionais na Europa, América Latina, Estados Unidos, África, Oriente Médio e Ásia.


Somos parceiros platinum da SAP e temos mais de 8.500 clientes . Nosso portfólio completo é voltado para empresas grandes, médias e em crescimento. Na SEIDOR acreditamos que, para enfrentar os novos desafios do mundo digital, devemos ter os melhores aliados, as tecnologias líderes de mercado e, acima de tudo, as melhores pessoas.


Nós acreditamos no valor das pessoas . Buscamos constantemente atrair e reter talentos, investindo no desenvolvimento de nossos colaboradores e oferecendo oportunidades de crescimento profissional. Nosso time é composto por profissionais colaborativos, autônomos e ágeis que juntos formam um ambiente de trabalho desafiador, dinâmico e sem discriminação, respeitando as diferenças que nos tornam mais humanos.

  • Prazo: Execução pontual das demandas.

title: UX Wordpress Elementor / Digital Display Ad & Video Ad / Mobile App Designers
description:
Please only apply if you are really a 'full stack' designer with a variety of seasoned skills incluidng design Elementor Wordpress AND digital display ads that are graphic intensive AND ad video shorts PLUS Bonus for Mobile App design.


Are you a dedicated, resourceful team player with strong creative skills and a portfolio of work which demonstrates passion for UX design with skills ranging from Wordpress Elementor sites & landing pages to ad sets to ad video shorts to mobile app design? Do you have experience working with numerous different design platforms especially in digital form, especially Adobe Creative Suite? Have you made eye-catching animated digital ads? Have you made social media video ads with AI characters like HeyGen and searched for stock video and audio footage based on the sales scripts?


Portfolio of web and digital ad design REQUIRED to be considered for the position.


About Us

Life Water Media specializes in digital branding and awareness campaigns for publicly traded companies and other large scale projects. We started in 2019.


Responsibilities

  • Handle multiple graphic projects from start to finish, adhering to set deadlines set by Creative Director.
  • Create UX landing pages on Wordpress with Elementor with provided copy and details set by Creative Director.
  • Create eye-catching display ads with animation on creatopy.com that stimulate visitors from Facebook, Google, etc
  • Create multiple variations of compelling, memorable logos, custom web graphics, web page designs, and digital media ads that reflect critical thinking and design excellence.
  • Stylize the copy provided from our writers into a custom Wordpress page so that it's aesthetically pleasing, professional, unique.
  • Review success of ads and suggest updates and new ads styles.
  • Create Web design layouts, company presentations, brochure, investor decks, infographics, and PowerPoint presentations.
  • Strong knowledge of UX design for websites, native and social apps
  • Open to using additional apps such as midjourney.com (unique ai images), creatopy.com (for automated ad sizing), (additional landing page platform, similar to Elementor), capcut, etc.
  • Able to make TikTok and Youtube ad video shorts based on sales scripts with stock video and audio
  • Able to make mobile app designs on Figma


Qualifications

  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite
  • Strong communication, conceptual thinking, typography skills and design skills
  • HTML/CSS design
  • Deadline and detail-oriented
  • Self Starter who can be self-taught and work without much direction
  • Works well in collaboration with a team and independently.
  • Must have excellent grammar skills
  • Must have the ability to multitask, work in a busy environment just as good as in solitude. This position requires a personality that can accept constructive criticism, change directions rapidly and accept new assignments frequently with pressing deadlines.


Compensation

Salary: based on your experience level

Bonuses: Performance and team share bonuses


To Apply Submit:

  • Current resume
  • Synopsis of recent salary history
  • Portfolio of your digital media work ranging from ads to web pages.


Requirements Before Employment

  • Short paid test project showcasing landing page, video and digital ads to assess work quality with our spec
  • Signed Independent Contractor Agreement and w8-Ben (USA tax form for International)


Company Culture

  • Remote
  • We're playful, tight nit, friendly, family-oriented atmosphere.
company: TD Media LLC (dba Life Water Media)

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Pride Global is hiring a Senior Software Engineer in Brazil. Please apply for consideration!!


Location: Remote (Brazil)

Employment Type: PJ - Open Ended


Job Summary

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our innovative team. You will develop high-quality, performant, and testable code contributing directly to company-wide initiatives using exciting technologies such as Elixir , Ruby, React , Typescript, GraphQL, Kafka, AWS Lambda, PostgreSQL, and DynamoDB.

You’ll have a strong influence on technical decisions, collaborate closely with product and engineering teams, and continuously improve your skills and our systems.


Responsibilities

  • Write high-quality, performant, and testable code aligned with company initiatives
  • Develop using technologies like Elixir, Ruby, React , Typescript, GraphQL, Kafka , AWS Lambda, PostgreSQL, and DynamoDB
  • Contribute to technical decision-making shaping the software’s future
  • Review pull requests and provide constructive feedback
  • Collaborate with team members on feature development
  • Deploy user-facing code to production
  • Partner with product and engineering management to deliver solutions


Required Qualifications

  • Professional English fluency (written and spoken)
  • 3-5+ years of software engineering experience
  • Strong communication skills
  • Experience with reusable components and building component libraries
  • Understanding of production-ready web applications and systems
  • Passion for testing practices and continuous improvement
  • Experience with any of: Elixir, Erlang, Ruby, Javascript, Next.js, or other programming languages
  • Familiarity with tools such as IDEs, RESTful APIs, Git, TypeScript, version control, and remote deployment
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience
  • Knowledge of event-based architectures, database fundamentals, and GraphQL
  • Enthusiasm for problem-solving and curiosity about retail/e-commerce, high-end consignment market, and sustainable circular economy for luxury goods

title: MSP Delivery Specialist (Bilingual English | Portuguese)
description:
About Pinnacle Group

Pinnacle Group is a trusted leader in workforce solutions and managed service provider (MSP) operations. We partner with enterprise clients to streamline contingent workforce management, strengthen supplier relationships, and ensure program compliance. Our mission is to deliver operational excellence through technology-driven solutions, industry expertise, and exceptional service quality across all facets of workforce delivery.


Summary

Pinnacle Group is seeking an MSP Delivery Specialist to manage the full life cycle of contingent workforce requests. This role serves as a key point of contact for client hiring managers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders, ensuring seamless requisition management, compliance, and operational success. The ideal candidate has strong experience in recruitment, MSP operations, and Vendor Management Systems (VMS), combined with a customer service mindset and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.


Job Description

  • Train, assist, and facilitate the requisition life cycle with client hiring managers and suppliers.
  • Support large-scale hiring initiatives, VMS data integrity projects, and supplier rationalization efforts.
  • Conduct intake calls, qualify candidate resumes, and manage requisition flow from posting through fulfillment.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with hiring managers, suppliers, and internal program teams to ensure program success.
  • Maintain a service-focused approach, delivering a high-quality experience to all stakeholders.
  • Utilize and provide training on MSP tool such as Beeline and applications including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
  • Ensure timely and accurate submission of required documentation by suppliers, maintaining adherence to SLAs and KPIs.
  • Support reporting, analytics, and client-specific initiatives as assigned.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience, preferably in a business-related field.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Must-haves:

  • 3–5 years of professional experience as a DevOps Engineer
  • AWS Experience – EC2, Security Groups, Command Line usage
  • Terraform Experience – Command line and coding experience to stand up cloud infrastructure, create/modify resources, and update permissions on security groups (following existing formats)
  • Linux Environment – Experience with Amazon Linux, system maintenance, troubleshooting, and scripting for installation and deployment
  • Scripting & Automation – Ability to write scripts for deployment using Packer or Terraform


Day-to-Day:

In this role, you will support infrastructure operations for a suite of software products. Responsibilities include managing permissions, handling one-off requests via Slack, resolving access issues, and supporting releases for new services. You’ll be responsible for patching and maintaining cloud infrastructure, primarily in a Linux environment. You’ll use AWS (EC2, Security Groups) and Terraform to manage infrastructure as code, following established formats. Tasks also include scripting for deployment and collaborating with engineering teams to ensure smooth operations. Some exposure to Windows environments is acceptable, though the focus is on Amazon Linux.


Benefits Information – CLT

This is a CLT opportunity. You are eligible for 15 days annual holidays/sick time and 30 days annual time off. Benefits also include an FTGS contribution, social security contribution, and a meal voucher. Annual salary will be paid in local currency (REAL), and ranges based on years of experience and skillset. Full details on time off listed below. Medical/healthcare is NOT provided due to the public healthcare system.

EOR (CLT) in Brazil have all the statutory benefits:

  • Meal Voucher
  • Social Security
  • Workers Compensation Insurance
  • State Pension Fund


Paid Time Off

Both full-time and part-time employees are entitled to 30 calendar days of paid time off (PTO) a year. PTO accrues monthly at 2.5 days per month. Employees are eligible for annual leave after 1 year of work. During the first year of employment, an employee is not allowed to take any leave.

title: Promotor e Assistente de Negócios - Lajeado/RS | Sicredi Integração RSMG
description:
Quer fazer parte de uma instituição que valoriza o cuidado com as pessoas, fortalece vínculos e gera impacto positivo nas regiões onde está presente? essa é a sua oportunidade! ✨

Estamos com vagas abertas para atuar como Promotor e Assistente de Negócios em diversas áreas e agências na nossa região de atuação – Lajeado e arredores .

Se você busca um ambiente colaborativo , com desenvolvimento contínuo e impacto positivo na comunidade , essa é a sua chance!


Vamos juntos construir ambientes de confiança, desenvolvimento e pertencimento.

✔Executar tarefas rotineiras de suporte e atendimento ao negócio e/ou suporte administrativo;

✔Realizar atendimento aos associados, contribuindo com a efetividade e fomento dos negócios;

✔Apoiar na formalização das operações, recebendo e conferindo documentos conforme as formalidades legais;

✔Preparar rotinas para garantir um atendimento mais ágil e eficiente às demandas dos associados.

✔Orientar os associados sobre o uso dos canais de autoatendimento;

✔Direcionar os associados conforme suas necessidades (plataforma de negócios ou guichês de caixa);

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including:
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral;
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels;
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons, and counterparty exposures;
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institution limits and capital requirements;
  • Net-worth monitoring.
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.

Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

title: Director of Salesforce Implementation
description:
Position Overview


The Director of Salesforce Implementation will lead a team of up to 15 Salesforce professionals across the US and LATAM, including consultants, developers, administrators, solution architects, and marketing automation specialists (MCAE and MCE). This role is responsible for project delivery excellence, ensuring projects are scoped accurately, executed effectively, delivered on time, and aligned with client expectations and IMG quality standards. The ideal candidate combines deep Salesforce expertise with proven team leadership, project governance, delivery operations, and client relationship skills. This director will serve as the operational leader of the implementation team, optimizing processes, reviewing time and utilization, providing coaching, managing escalations, and driving exceptional customer satisfaction.


Key Responsibilities


Team Leadership and Management

  • Lead and mentor a cross-functional Salesforce implementation team across US and LATAM.
  • Provide coaching, one-on-ones, growth planning, and performance management.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and high-quality delivery.
  • Manage staffing, capacity planning, and resource allocation across all active projects.


Project and Delivery Oversight

  • Oversee all Salesforce implementation projects including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud Account Engagement (MCAE), Marketing Cloud Engagement (MCE), and integrations.
  • Conduct regular project reviews to ensure progress, scope alignment, and adherence to timelines.
  • Monitor time tracking, utilization, and project budgets; identify trends and address over-burn or under-delivery risks.
  • Establish and refine delivery processes, best practices, and standard operating procedures.


Quality Control and Customer Satisfaction

  • Ensure projects meet IMG quality standards and deliver measurable business value.
  • Provide strategic oversight and intervention on escalations or complex project challenges.
  • Maintain high levels of customer satisfaction through proactive communication and alignment.
  • Partner with the Sales team during handoff to ensure a smooth transition from scoping to delivery.


Operational Excellence

  • Develop and maintain predictable implementation workflows and project governance frameworks.
  • Improve reporting and tracking across project health, timelines, scope changes, and team utilization.
  • Implement delivery tools, templates, documentation standards, and internal QA processes.
  • Collaborate with leadership on forecasting, hiring needs, and Salesforce practice growth.


Cross-Department Collaboration

  • Work closely with the Sales, Customer Success, and Operations teams to ensure alignment across the client lifecycle.
  • Participate in internal strategic planning, service-offering refinement, and productization of Salesforce packages such as Jumpstart.
  • Support revenue growth by identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities during implementation.


Qualifications


Required

  • 7 or more years of Salesforce implementation experience (consulting or client-side).
  • 3 or more years leading technical or consulting teams, preferably remote or geographically distributed.
  • Strong knowledge of Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and marketing automation platforms (MCAE and MCE).
  • Proven ability to manage multiple simultaneous projects and large-scale client engagements.
  • Experience with resource planning, time tracking, utilization reporting, and delivery KPIs.
  • Strong communication, leadership, and conflict resolution skills.
  • Ability to operate at both the strategic and tactical levels.


Preferred

  • Salesforce certifications.
  • Experience at a Salesforce partner agency or professional services organization.
  • Background with project management tools such as Asana, Monday, or Wrike.
  • Experience with US, LATAM, and offshore team management.


What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and performance bonus structure.
  • Flexible remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to lead a rapidly expanding Salesforce practice.
  • Supportive leadership and a culture focused on growth, innovation, and client success.
  • Professional development opportunities and Salesforce certification support.
  • Paid time off, paid holidays, and emphasis on work-life balance.

title: Analista de Customer Sucess Pleno
description:
Missão do cargo:

Construir uma base sólida para o crescimento sustentável da carteira de clientes do segmento de RH, garantindo que a empresa cliente possa escalar suas operações de RH de maneira eficaz e mantendo a satisfação do cliente com as soluções TOTVS.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Estabelecer relacionamentos sólidos com o departamento de Recursos Humanos e principais stakeholders do cliente, visando entender desafios e oportunidades para direcionar o RH na implementação de processos eficientes através das soluções de folha de pagamento e gestão de ponto eletrônico TOTVS;
  • Responsável pela totalidade da receita recorrente de uma carteira de clientes, atuando proativamente para a adoção de soluções de RH e mitigação do risco churn, assegurando a execução e sucesso na jornada do cliente. É essencial ter autogestão, organização e proatividade;
  • Realizar reuniões estratégicas periódicas com clientes e demais stakeholders, buscando promover um relacionamento parceiro que favoreça o crescimento e a eficácia do negócio através das soluções para RH TOTVS.
  • Conduzir ações que integrem diferentes áreas do cliente e da TOTVS, facilitando o desenvolvimento de projetos e processos. Deve ter adaptabilidade, capacidade de lidar com mudanças em ambientes dinâmicos, além de trabalho em equipe e colaboração;
  • Monitorar periodicamente indicadores de desempenho e métricas de satisfação do cliente; com foco em resultados e na gestão de produtividade e performance de metas;
  • Resiliência ao lidar com resolução de problemas e negociação de demandas;


Requisitos e qualificações

O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:


Formação: Superior em Recursos Humanos, Ciências Contábeis ou áreas correlatas;


  • Conhecimento em legislação trabalhista, software de folha de pagamento e ponto eletrônico;

title: Analista de Projetos (Pl)
description:
Somos protagonistas na transformação digital dos meios de pagamento, somos a HST!

Desvendamos os desafios mais complexos e desde a nossa fundação temos a missão de tornar as transações eletrônicas mais seguras.

Estamos presentes em +20 Países e, dentre os nossos Clientes, estão os 8 Bancos mais importantes do Brasil e os 20 da América Latina!

São +80.000 terminais de autoatendimento; +1.000.000 autenticações de transações de compras eletrônicas ao mês; +800.000 cartões bancários com chip disponibilizados ao mês em lojas e agências bancárias; e até em 2024, foram +100 bancos utilizando nossos sistemas de emissor que permitem a tokenização de cartões COF (Card on File) e eCommerce. Isso é só uma parte dos nossos resultados, mas também é só começo!

Nos bastidores de todas as nossas conquistas está o nosso Time, que conta com +200 Pessoas envolvidas no desenvolvimento das nossas soluções. Pessoas questionadoras, curiosas, criativas, proativas, colaborativas e abertas a novas experiências!


Para saber mais sobre a HST e sobre as nossas oportunidades, acesse:


Buscamos uma pessoa Analista de Projetos (Pl) para se unir ao nosso Time de Projects para:

  • Participação de reuniões internas e externas com clientes;
  • Organização das demandas de projetos de acordo o processo definido, com boas práticas do PMBOK e metodologias ágeis;
  • Gerenciamento de solicitações e atividades não previstas em projetos;
  • Realização de atividades operacionais de gestão de projetos;
  • Gerenciamento de contas de projetos de clientes nacionais e internacionais;
  • Acompanhamento de reuniões e atividades de marcos de projetos;
  • Acompanhamento KPIs de projetos;
  • Asseguração da conformidade com padrões e procedimentos internos;
  • Facilitação da comunicação com Stakeholders;
  • Condução de revisões periódicas de projetos;
  • Gerenciamento e planejamento de marcos de faturamento (garantia de receita).


Acreditamos ser importante que você já tenha passado por algumas experiências e que também tenha os seguintes conhecimentos:

  • Formação completa em TI ou área relacionada;
  • Experiência de ao menos um ano atuando como líder de projetos em contato direto com clientes;
  • Conhecimento sólido em MS Projects, Excel, Cronogramas;
  • Conhecimentos de PMBOK/Scrum/Kanban;
  • Espanhol avançado.


Será um grande diferencial se:

  • Conhecimento em Jira;
  • Conhecimento em Power BI;
  • Inglês intermediário;
  • Conhecimento com produtos ou com conceitos relacionados a meios de pagamento.


O que oferecemos?

A HST é uma empresa certificada GPTW! Oferecemos a oportunidade de crescimento em um ambiente de desafios em que a contrapartida de cada Pessoa equivale ao tamanho da sua vontade de crescer !

  • Contratação em regime CLT;
  • Atuação 100% Remota
  • Horário flexível;
  • Oportunidade de crescimento, através do contínuo desenvolvimento, tanto técnico quanto pessoal;
  • Temos programas de desenvolvimento destinado às novas lideranças;
  • 10% das horas mensais, podem ser dedicadas para aprender algo novo;
  • Day-Off no mês do aniversário;
  • Ajuda de Custo Home Office;
  • Licença Maternidade e Paternidade Ampliadas;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • WellHub (antiga Gympass);
  • Convênio médico;
  • Convênio odontológico;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição;
  • Vale Transporte ou estacionamento;
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Seguro de Vida.


Prezamos por um bom ambiente de trabalho que contribua para as pessoas evoluírem e se sentirem acolhidas, livres, autênticas e à vontade para demonstrarem suas habilidades! Apoiamos a diversidade e não temos espaço para qualquer tipo de discriminação!

title: Desenvolvedor Mobile Jr
description:
Desenvolvedor Mobile Jr | CLT | Remoto


Sobre nós

A Control iD é uma indústria brasileira, especializada no desenvolvimento de relógio de ponto, controle de acesso e equipamentos para automação comercial. Fazemos parte do grupo ASSA ABLOY.


Sobre a Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Mobile Júnior apaixonado(a) por tecnologia e ansioso(a) para começar sua carreira no desenvolvimento de aplicativos móveis. Você fará parte de uma equipe multidisciplinar, contribuindo diretamente para o desenvolvimento e manutenção de nossos aplicativos.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver novas funcionalidades para os aplicativos (iOS e Android), seguindo as especificações técnicas e de design.
  • Auxiliar na manutenção e correção de bugs nos aplicativos existentes.
  • Participar ativamente das reuniões de planejamento e code review da equipe.
  • Escrever código limpo, bem documentado e testável.
  • Aprender continuamente sobre as novas tecnologias e práticas do ecossistema mobile.


Requisitos Essenciais

  • Experiência mínima de 6 meses a 1 ano (incluindo projetos pessoais, acadêmicos ou estágios) em desenvolvimento mobile.
  • Conhecimento em Flutter
  • Familiaridade com conceitos básicos de APIs RESTful e integração com serviços backend.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de controle de versão (Git).
  • Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou área correlata.
  • Proatividade, boa comunicação e vontade de aprender.


Diferenciais (Não Obrigatórios, mas Valorizados)

  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Noções de testes unitários e testes de integração.


Benefícios da posição


  • 100% remoto;
  • VR/VA sem desconto em folha;
  • Convênio médico com coparticipação apenas quando usar;
  • PLR;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Totalpass.

title: Advogado(a) Sênior
description:
Advogado(a) Sênior – Temporário

Local: 2 dias em São José dos Campos/ SP; 1 dia em Itupeva/ SP; 2 dias remoto.

Contrato: Temporário – licença maternidade.


Advogado(a) devidamente inscrito na OAB, com conhecimento e experiência em processos e procedimentos jurídicos, com atuação estratégica para mitigação de risco e identificação de oportunidades para potencializar o sucesso no resultado, apto a acompanhar processos judiciais e administrativos; elaborar notificações judiciais e extrajudiciais; negociar e analisar contratos em diversas área; elaborar cartas, notificações, contratos e recursos administrativos em geral; emitir parecer interno sobre questões jurídicas e contratuais, com interface com cliente interno; bem como maturidade profissional e emocional, poder de decisão, com capacidade para assumir funções de liderança, com bom relacionamento interpessoal.


Requisitos

  • Superior Completo em Direito, com Pós Graduação;
  • Experiência na área jurídica, diferencial que tenha experiência em empresa Multinacional;
  • Prática processual e contratual, com desenvoltura na escrita e oralidade;
  • Acessibilidade e bom relacionamento interpessoal;
  • Proatividade;
  • Disciplina, organização e senso de urgência;
  • Conhecimentos do pacote Office, principalmente Excel;
  • Inglês - Avançado


Principais Atividades:

  • Suportar o Departamento de Procurement no atendimento ao cliente interno nas contratações e gestão do contencioso com interface com escritórios externos.
  • Elaboração, análise e revisões de minutas contratuais;
  • Desenvolvimento de novas minutas contratuais conforme necessidade do cliente interno;
  • Gestão de contratos (NDA, Fornecimento de Materiais Produtivos e Improdutivos, Prestação de Serviço, Compra e Venda, Comodato, Locação de Imóveis, dentre outros, com observância de SLA);

title: Infrastructure automation engineer
description:
Title: Infrastructure automation engineer

Location: Remote


The Lead, Infrastructure automation engineer role is part of the Cloud and Compute engineering organisation to drive an improved developer experience and automation first approach for adoption of public and hybrid cloud computing environment in a secured manner. This role will be passionate about developing cloud-agnostic infrastructure provisioning and lifecycle management automation, ensuring associated security and compliance guardrails to meet application hosting requirements. The role is foran individual contributor who will develop Terraform, Chef and Python REST API based automation for automated provisioning, change, and decommission of VM, IaaS and PaaS database and Cloud resources in public cloud AWS, Azure, GCP and private cloud.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and enforce CIS security standards for Windows and Linux operating systems using Chef or similar configuration management tools.
  • Deliver new cloud services to the business, while simplifying and improving service consumption and operational management
  • Leverage Python REST APIs to develop “Zero” touch provisioning, patching, change and decommissioning of VM, Kubernetes, PaaS database for lifecycle management of Hybrid Cloud resources.
  • Develop REST APIs in python using BDD methodology and implement public cloud security guardrails.
  • Partner with Kenvue application teams for proof of technology in public cloud computing environment.
  • Build Hybrid Cloud infrastructure provisioning workflows leveraging continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines (CI/CD) running on Jenkins and or other CI CD tools.
  • Partner with Kenvue application teams and drive resolution of sophisticated technical problems across infrastructure and application stack.
  • Design, engineer, implement Infrastructure As Code with API first and microservices based approach for public cloud service.
  • Leverage internal and external resources to develop, advance and retain talent.
  • Review current processes and find opportunities for automation and build common frameworks in agile manner that cultivate adoption of automation across all layers.
  • Groom Jira features and stories to improve reliability and reduce support incidents for global infrastructure

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree required, preferably in STEM field.
  • 5 years of progressive experience in a combination of development, design in areas of cloud computing and infrastructure engineering.
  • Strong Infrastructure as a Code (IaC) experience on hybrid cloud environment,
  • Observability, through tools such as Prometheus, Elasticsearch, Grafana, DataDog or Zipkin is a plus.
  • 2+ years hands-on experience in Chef or similar config management tool is required
  • 2+ years hands-on experience in AWS, Azure, or GCP is required
  • Experience building Restful APIs is required.
  • 1+ year of Terraform experience.
  • Experience in Kubernetes is preferred
  • VMware experience is preferred.
  • Open-Source virtualization experience like KVM and Ovirt is preferred.
  • Understanding of GIT-based source code management, Continuous Integration, and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) practices using tools like Jenkins, Bitbucket, Artifactory, Groovy Scripting
  • Strong understanding of agile development processes and Agile tool set JIRA Python development experience is preferred but development experience with one or more of the following languages may be acceptable: Go, Scala, Java, Ruby, Python
  • Experience in supporting global operations and following enterprise level process frameworks. Good social, oral and written communication skills are preferred.
  • Self-starter with positive relationship abilities and customer service skills is preferred

title: Engenheiro de Dados - BeFly
description:
Somos o ecossistema de turismo mais transformador na vida de cada pessoa! A paixão por viagens está em nosso DNA.

Nossos escritórios proporcionam um ambiente moderno e pensado para uma melhor experiência de trabalho presencial. Somos múltiplos e diversos, gostamos de trabalhar com gente do bem, de forma inteligente, prática, ousada, inovadora e com tudo isso, buscamos o extraordinário.

Valorizamos as conexões reais e ambientes leves, seja através do cafezinho no meio de expediente ou aquele papo, que sempre gera novas ideias.

O que nos move é a transformação e nosso lema é criar caminhos além do imaginável!

Isso nos torna BeFly. E aí, você vem com a gente?

#VemSerBeFly


Confira As Principais Atividades Desta Vaga

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter pipelines de ingestão, transformação e disponibilização de dados (ETL/ELT).
  • Estruturar e manter arquiteturas de dados escaláveis (Data Lake / Data Warehouse) com foco em performance e integridade.
  • Integrar dados de diferentes fontes, incluindo sistemas legados, APIs e plataformas SaaS do setor de turismo.
  • Trabalhar com equipes multidisciplinares (engenharia, BI, produto e operações) para entregar soluções orientadas a dados.
  • Garantir qualidade, versionamento, governança e rastreabilidade dos dados.
  • Aplicar boas práticas de engenharia e contribuir para a definição da arquitetura de dados da empresa.


Curtiu?! Vamos em frente, entenda o que esperamos de você:

  • Forte domínio em Python e SQL.
  • Experiência comprovada como Engenheiro(a) de Dados (mínimo 5 anos)
  • Experiência com ferramentas como Airflow, Spark, dbt, Kafka.
  • Vivência com plataformas de cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure).
  • Experiência com bancos relacionais e NoSQL.
  • Conhecimento em versionamento com Git e pipelines de CI/CD.
  • Experiência no setor de turismo corporativo ou atuação em empresas de tecnologia com foco em mobilidade ou viagens.
  • Familiaridade com plataformas SaaS do setor de turismo, como:
  • OBTs (Online Booking Tools), ex: Argo, Reservia, SAP Concur, Onfly
  • GDS (Global Distribution Systems), ex: Amadeus, Sabre
  • Experiência com ferramentas analíticas e de BI (Power BI, Tableau, Looker)
  • Certificações cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Experiência em projetos de dados com múltiplas integrações e alto volume transacional
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura orientada a eventos
  • Experiencia de implantação de data lake.


Quais os benefícios de ser BeFlyer?

  • VR iFood Benefícios | Para que você se alimente bem.
  • Vale-transporte | Para facilitar sua locomoção.
  • Assistência médica Bradesco | Mensalidade 100% paga pela BeFly ao colaborador titular e 50% para dependentes, com comparticipação.
  • Seguro de vida | Sem custo para o colaborador.
  • Assistência odontológica | OdontoPrev.
  • Wellhub | Para você cuidar da sua saúde física.
  • Day off de aniversário | Um dia de descanso no seu aniversário.
  • Programa de maternidade | Pacote com diversos cuidados para uma gestação tranquila.
  • Programa Oriente-me | Sessões de terapia sem custo adicional.
  • Estacionamento na sede | Desconto exclusivo para colaboradores.
  • Convênios educacionais | Descontos em instituições de ensino parceiras.
  • BeFlyers Travel | Agência de lazer interna com condições especiais para colaboradores.

Nossos escritórios proporcionam um ambiente moderno e pensado para uma melhor experiência de trabalho presencial. Somos múltiplos e diversos, gostamos de trabalhar com gente do bem, de forma inteligente, prática, ousada, inovadora e com tudo isso, buscamos o extraordinário.

Valorizamos as conexões reais e ambientes leves, seja através do cafezinho no meio de expediente ou aquele papo, que sempre gera novas ideias.

O que nos move é a transformação e nosso lema é criar caminhos além do imaginável!

Isso nos torna BeFly. E aí, você vem com a gente?

#VemSerBeFly


Confira As Principais Atividades Desta Vaga

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter pipelines de ingestão, transformação e disponibilização de dados (ETL/ELT).
  • Estruturar e manter arquiteturas de dados escaláveis (Data Lake / Data Warehouse) com foco em performance e integridade.
  • Integrar dados de diferentes fontes, incluindo sistemas legados, APIs e plataformas SaaS do setor de turismo.
  • Trabalhar com equipes multidisciplinares (engenharia, BI, produto e operações) para entregar soluções orientadas a dados.
  • Garantir qualidade, versionamento, governança e rastreabilidade dos dados.
  • Aplicar boas práticas de engenharia e contribuir para a definição da arquitetura de dados da empresa.


Curtiu?! Vamos em frente, entenda o que esperamos de você:

  • Forte domínio em Python e SQL.
  • Experiência comprovada como Engenheiro(a) de Dados (mínimo 5 anos)
  • Experiência com ferramentas como Airflow, Spark, dbt, Kafka.
  • Vivência com plataformas de cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure).
  • Experiência com bancos relacionais e NoSQL.
  • Conhecimento em versionamento com Git e pipelines de CI/CD.
  • Experiência no setor de turismo corporativo ou atuação em empresas de tecnologia com foco em mobilidade ou viagens.
  • Familiaridade com plataformas SaaS do setor de turismo, como:
  • OBTs (Online Booking Tools), ex: Argo, Reservia, SAP Concur, Onfly
  • GDS (Global Distribution Systems), ex: Amadeus, Sabre
  • Experiência com ferramentas analíticas e de BI (Power BI, Tableau, Looker)
  • Certificações cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Experiência em projetos de dados com múltiplas integrações e alto volume transacional
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura orientada a eventos
  • Experiencia de implantação de data lake.


Quais os benefícios de ser BeFlyer?

  • VR iFood Benefícios | Para que você se alimente bem.
  • Vale-transporte | Para facilitar sua locomoção.
  • Assistência médica Bradesco | Mensalidade 100% paga pela BeFly ao colaborador titular e 50% para dependentes, com comparticipação.
  • Seguro de vida | Sem custo para o colaborador.
  • Assistência odontológica | OdontoPrev.
  • Wellhub | Para você cuidar da sua saúde física.
  • Day off de aniversário | Um dia de descanso no seu aniversário.
  • Programa de maternidade | Pacote com diversos cuidados para uma gestação tranquila.
  • Programa Oriente-me | Sessões de terapia sem custo adicional.
  • Estacionamento na sede | Desconto exclusivo para colaboradores.
  • Convênios educacionais | Descontos em instituições de ensino parceiras.
  • BeFlyers Travel | Agência de lazer interna com condições especiais para colaboradores.

title: ServiceNow Technical Expert
description:
ServiceNow Technical Expert

Organization: BEXIT (Business Excellence & IT Strategy)

Reporting: Reports to Christian Daller, Head of BEXIT

Position Type: Individual Contributor


Role Description:

The ServiceNow Technical Expert will play a pivotal role in building and evolving ServiceNow as the “IT ERP” for the newco IT organization. This individual will take hands-on architectural decisions, guide and supervise external partners in development and application management, and directly contribute to configuration, development, and administration of ServiceNow. The role will consult and guide on architectural and configuration decisions across a broad range of modules—including SPM, ITSM, ITOM, HR, VR, custom apps, integrations, and more—ensuring ServiceNow meets the needs of a modern, integrated IT landscape.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Make hands-on architectural decisions for ServiceNow configuration and development.
  • Guide and supervise external partners responsible for ServiceNow development and application management.
  • Perform configuration, development, and administration tasks within ServiceNow.
  • Collaborate closely with the DSM ServiceNow, Enterprise Architect, and Process Owners to ensure alignment with strategic roadmaps and project scopes.
  • Investigate and advise on module usage, integrations, and platform capabilities across such as, but not limited to, SPM, ITSM, ITOM, HR, VR, and custom applications.
  • Ensure platform design follows best practices and avoids unnecessary customization or technical debt.
  • Represent BEXIT as a subject matter expert in cross-functional meetings and initiatives
  • Training: Provide Training regarding ServiceNow stretching from End Users to Technical Staff and Architects.


Expectations:

  • Prioritize out-of-the-box functionality and avoid custom development unless justified by business case, legal, EHS, or security requirements.
  • Follow ServiceNow best practices to ensure scalability, maintainability, and minimal technical debt.
  • Demonstrate proactive problem-solving and consultative guidance across modules.
  • Maintain clear and effective communication with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Ensure all architectural decisions are aligned with the enterprise roadmap and scoped demands.


Qualifications:

  • Must-Have: ServiceNow Administrator certification or equivalent. Additional certifications in the context of ITIL functionality are beneficial.
  • Proven experience in scripting and integration within ServiceNow.
  • Strong stakeholder management and interpersonal skills.
  • Basic knowledge of project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid).


  • Nice-to-Have: Familiarity with architectural frameworks such as CSDM and TOGAF.
  • Experience across multiple ServiceNow modules.
  • Understanding of enterprise IT transformation and ERP-like platform design.


Authorization:

  • Make architectural and configuration decisions within the roadmap provided by the Enterprise Architect and the scope defined by Process Owners and DSMs.
  • Represent BEXIT in cross-functional meetings and initiatives as a subject matter expert (SME).
  • Approve configuration and development work that aligns with best practices and avoids unnecessary customization or technical debt.
  • Guide and supervise external partners in development and application management activities.

title: Product Engineer
description:
Product Engineer (Node.js / React / AdTech) – Contract (6+ Months, Extension Likely)

Location: Remote (EU Time Zones)

Contract Length: 6 months – strong potential for long-term extensions

Start: ASAP

Tech Stack: Node.js, React, APIs, Social/YouTube integrations, AdTech, Creator/UGC discovery


About the Role

We’re looking for a highly experienced Product Engineer to help build a next-generation AdTech platform , supporting categories such as beauty, lifestyle, UGC, and topic-based recommendations for a Euro Retail and Marketing powerhouse.


This contract role sits inside a fast-moving, cross-functional product team building internal tools and white-labelled solutions used across wider business units. You’ll be responsible for scoping, designing, and developing features end-to-end — from backend services to polished, user-friendly front-end experiences.


This is a hands-on build role , perfect for an engineer with strong product instincts and experience delivering consumer-facing or AdTech-driven discovery systems.


Key Responsibilities

Product Engineering & Feature Ownership

  • Build and evolve a creator discovery solution end-to-end using Node.js and React
  • Own product features from concept → prototype → implementation → iteration
  • Work closely with product managers, data teams, and internal partners to define requirements
  • Rapidly test, validate, and iterate on user workflows and ranking experiences


API & Platform Integrations

  • Integrate with social-platform APIs (e.g., YouTube Data API , Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest)
  • Develop services to ingest, enrich, and structure creator data (categories, topics, UGC signals, relevance scoring)
  • Optimise ingestion and discovery pipelines for performance and scale


AdTech & Recommendation Work

  • Build components that support advertising partners, sponsorship matching, and creator-brand fit
  • Implement logic for topic/category classification, recommendation ranking, and metadata structuring
  • Work on internal tools and white-label solutions used by cross-functional teams


Backend & Frontend Engineering

  • Build scalable backend services in Node.js (REST, GraphQL, event-driven services)
  • Develop polished UIs in React , ensuring high usability and clarity for internal teams
  • Ensure strong code quality, automated testing, and reliable CI/CD


Collaboration & Delivery

  • Partner closely with engineering leads, PMs, data scientists, and marketing/AdTech teams
  • Operate in a rapid, iterative environment with short feedback loops
  • Participate in architectural decisions and contribute to long-term platform direction
  • Support a healthy engineering culture focused on velocity, clarity, and product impact


Required Experience

  • 5+ years as a product-focused engineer
  • Strong hands-on experience with Node.js and React
  • Experience integrating with social media APIs (YouTube essential; Instagram/TikTok/Pinterest a plus)
  • Experience in AdTech, marketing tech, creator platforms, or discovery/recommendation systems
  • Experience building internal tools, dashboards, or white-label solutions
  • Strong product mindset — comfortable owning features, making trade-offs, and shipping iteratively
  • Ability to translate ambiguous ideas into clear technical plans
  • Strong communication, stakeholder alignment, and cross-functional collaboration


Nice to Have

  • Experience with video/content metadata (categories, beauty, topics, “lookalike” discovery)
  • Understanding of ranking, scoring, or classification models
  • Background with UGC/creator ecosystems (YouTube creators, UGC workflows, performance marketing)
  • Experience with event-driven microservices or data pipelines
  • GraphQL experience
  • Experience in high-scale consumer-facing platforms


Why This Role?

  • High-impact greenfield project
  • Central to the business’ advertising & creator strategy
  • Autonomy to shape the product and tech direction
  • Flexible remote contract with extensions very likely

This contract role sits inside a fast-moving, cross-functional product team building internal tools and white-labelled solutions used across wider business units. You’ll be responsible for scoping, designing, and developing features end-to-end — from backend services to polished, user-friendly front-end experiences.


This is a hands-on build role , perfect for an engineer with strong product instincts and experience delivering consumer-facing or AdTech-driven discovery systems.


Key Responsibilities

Product Engineering & Feature Ownership

  • Build and evolve a creator discovery solution end-to-end using Node.js and React
  • Own product features from concept → prototype → implementation → iteration
  • Work closely with product managers, data teams, and internal partners to define requirements
  • Rapidly test, validate, and iterate on user workflows and ranking experiences


API & Platform Integrations

  • Integrate with social-platform APIs (e.g., YouTube Data API , Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest)
  • Develop services to ingest, enrich, and structure creator data (categories, topics, UGC signals, relevance scoring)
  • Optimise ingestion and discovery pipelines for performance and scale


AdTech & Recommendation Work

  • Build components that support advertising partners, sponsorship matching, and creator-brand fit
  • Implement logic for topic/category classification, recommendation ranking, and metadata structuring
  • Work on internal tools and white-label solutions used by cross-functional teams


Backend & Frontend Engineering

  • Build scalable backend services in Node.js (REST, GraphQL, event-driven services)
  • Develop polished UIs in React , ensuring high usability and clarity for internal teams
  • Ensure strong code quality, automated testing, and reliable CI/CD


Collaboration & Delivery

  • Partner closely with engineering leads, PMs, data scientists, and marketing/AdTech teams
  • Operate in a rapid, iterative environment with short feedback loops
  • Participate in architectural decisions and contribute to long-term platform direction
  • Support a healthy engineering culture focused on velocity, clarity, and product impact


Required Experience

  • 5+ years as a product-focused engineer
  • Strong hands-on experience with Node.js and React
  • Experience integrating with social media APIs (YouTube essential; Instagram/TikTok/Pinterest a plus)
  • Experience in AdTech, marketing tech, creator platforms, or discovery/recommendation systems
  • Experience building internal tools, dashboards, or white-label solutions
  • Strong product mindset — comfortable owning features, making trade-offs, and shipping iteratively
  • Ability to translate ambiguous ideas into clear technical plans
  • Strong communication, stakeholder alignment, and cross-functional collaboration


Nice to Have

  • Experience with video/content metadata (categories, beauty, topics, “lookalike” discovery)
  • Understanding of ranking, scoring, or classification models
  • Background with UGC/creator ecosystems (YouTube creators, UGC workflows, performance marketing)
  • Experience with event-driven microservices or data pipelines
  • GraphQL experience
  • Experience in high-scale consumer-facing platforms


Why This Role?

  • High-impact greenfield project
  • Central to the business’ advertising & creator strategy
  • Autonomy to shape the product and tech direction
  • Flexible remote contract with extensions very likely

title: Anti-Money Laundering Manager
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain AML/CFT and sanctions policies and procedures aligned with Brazilian regulatory requirements and global best practices.
  • Regulatory interface (inspections, responses, remediation plans)
  • Conduct customer due diligence (CDD/KYC/KYB) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) reviews in accordance with risk-based methodologies.
  • Support ongoing transaction monitoring, screening, and investigation of suspicious activities.
  • Prepare, review, and file Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) and other regulatory filings with COAF or relevant authorities.
  • Monitor developments in AML/CFT and sanctions laws, and assist in updating internal procedures accordingly.
  • Assist in the delivery of internal training and awareness sessions on AML/CFT and sanctions compliance.
  • Conduct periodic risk assessments, ensuring all controls are operating effectively and aligned with the company’s enterprise risk management framework.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and audit trails for all compliance reviews, escalations, and filings.
  • Support internal and external audits, as well as inspections or information requests from regulators.
  • Coordinate with Legal, Risk, Operations, and Technology teams to strengthen compliance systems and data integrity.
  • Contribute to the assessment and oversight of third-party vendors that support AML/CFT and compliance operations.


Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in AML/CFT and sanctions compliance experience in financial, fintech, or VASP sectors.
  • Proven ability to operate independently as part of the second line of defense.
  • Strong understanding of COAF, Central Bank of Brazil, and CVM regulations, as well as FATF standards.
  • Proficient in KYC/KYB, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Economics, or related field; postgraduate or certification (e.g., CAMS, ICA) preferred.
  • Excellent analytical skills, professional integrity, and fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors, including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

title: Representante de Vendas
description:
About Refer

Refer is an exclusive AI-powered career agent that connects top talent from Stanford, MIT, Harvard, and other top 20 US universities to leading tech companies like NVIDIA, Meta, Glean, DeepMind, Scale AI, and 1,000+ startups.


We are expanding rapidly and launching a Refer & Earn program so more people can help us grow this elite talent community — and get rewarded for it.


✨ About the Role

We’re looking for Sales Representatives who want a flexible, remote opportunity to help talented people find great jobs — and get paid extremely well for it.


This is not a typical “marketing” or “recruiting” job.


Your role is simple:

Share Refer with people who qualify

When they join and get accepted — you earn

If they get hired — you earn big

That's it.


Compensation (Commission Only)

You earn:

  • $50 for every qualified user you bring who signs up
  • $1,000 if they get hired or make a hire through Refer

There is no limit to how much you can earn.

Some ambassadors make a few hundred dollars per week.

Some make thousands.


Who Should Apply

This role is perfect for people who:

  • Are active on LinkedIn
  • Have friends from top universities
  • Know people in tech or startups
  • Are involved in online communities
  • Want a flexible side gig with high upside
  • Want to help people find jobs that match their potential

No experience required.

Just bring people to Refer — we do the rest.


Who Qualifies to Be Referred

You’ll have the most success referring people who are:

  • Job seekers with a degree from a top 20 US university , OR
  • Hiring managers / team leads at top tech companies or startups
  • US-based only

You’ll receive more details and tools after joining.


What You’ll Do

As a Sales Representative, you will:

  • Promote Refer
  • Post about Refer in relevant online communities
  • Invite top talent and hiring managers to join
  • Use your unique invitation link to track earnings
  • Help us grow the strongest talent network in the country

We’ll provide:

  • Messaging templates
  • Guidance on where to promote
  • Best practices to maximize your earnings

title: Analista Funcional Funcional OTC (PJ | Remoto)
description:
Tipo de Contrato: PJ

Location: remoto


Sobre a vaga:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista Funcional Sênior com sólida experiência em Oracle EBS e experiência e conhecimentos em meios de pagamentos digitais . Este profissional atuará em projetos estratégicos, sendo responsável por levantar requisitos, propor soluções funcionais e garantir a integração eficiente entre sistemas ERP e plataformas de pagamento online.


Responsabilidades:

- Ser referência funcional de produtos digitais voltados a meios de pagamento .

- Levantamento e análise de requisitos funcionais - área de produto / negócio.

- Atuação em módulos Oracle EBS (principalmente AR, AP, OM) - processo OTC.

- Atuação em projetos de integração com gateways de pagamento, adquirentes e plataformas de transações online.

- Mapeamento de processos relacionados a pagamentos online, conciliação financeira e antifraude.

- Elaboração de documentos funcionais (especificações, casos de uso, etc).

- Interface com o time de desenvolvedores para validação/acompanhamento das soluções, desenvolvimentos e dos testes técnicos.

- Apoio na homologação e validação de entregas junto ao Product Manager.

- Apoio na construção de roadmap junto ao Product Manager.


Requisitos:

- Experiência comprovada como Analista Funcional em projetos com Oracle EBS.

- Conhecimento funcional nos módulos financeiros e de faturamento (AR, AP, OM).

- Vivência com meios de pagamento: gateways, adquirentes, APIs de pagamento, conciliação.

- Capacidade de traduzir requisitos de negócio em especificações funcionais claras.

- Habilidade de comunicação com áreas técnicas e não técnicas.

- Boa visão analítica sobre produtos.

- Forte senso de responsabilidade - ter postura de dono do produto.


Diferenciais:

- Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

- Certificações Oracle ou em meios de pagamento.

- Experiência com projetos de e-commerce ou plataformas de pagamento digital.

title: Senior Java Technical Lead (AI-Augmented Development)
description:
QAT Global , a US-based IT consulting firm with over 30 years of experience, is seeking a highly skilled Senior Java Technical Lead to join our global engineering team. We deliver world-class technology solutions to clients across the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil, with a strong culture of engineering excellence and innovation.


This is a full-time, 100% remote position (CLT hire in Brazil only), offering the opportunity to work directly with our US-based customer while collaborating with cross-functional, distributed teams. Advanced English proficiency is mandatory, as you will communicate daily with US stakeholders.


About the Role


As a Senior Java Technical Lead , you will be responsible for leading all technical decision-making across backend and frontend development, ensuring architectural consistency, engineering best practices, and high-quality code delivery.

This role requires an expert-level Java professional who has begun integrating AI-assisted development workflows , including LLMs such as GPT and Claude, into their software engineering practices.


You will lead full-stack developers, collaborate closely with Solution Architects, BAs, DevOps, and AI Engineers, and oversee complex business domains such as Billing, Ledger, Invoice, and Remittance .

If you are a seasoned Java engineer who is also evolving into the new era of AI-enhanced software development, this role is for you.


Responsibilities


  • Lead all technical decision-making across backend and frontend architecture.
  • Ensure code quality, engineering best practices, and architectural coherence.
  • Guide full-stack developers implementing backend services and UI components.
  • Collaborate with Solution Architect, BA, DevOps, and AI Engineer to translate requirements into scalable, secure solutions.
  • Oversee complex financial and operational domains (Billing, Ledger, Invoice, Remittance).
  • Design, supervise, and optimize workflows that leverage LLMs for code generation, review, and refactoring.
  • Provide technical leadership on when and how to use AI tools safely and effectively.


Required Qualifications


Core Engineering Skills:


  • Senior-level Java/Spring Boot experience (expert level required).

title: Regulatory Research Analyst
description:
Job Title: Regulatory Research Analyst

Location: Brazil

Work Mode: 100% Remote

Employment Type: Independent Contractor (hourly pay, no benefits, and you’re responsible for your own taxes)

Contract Duration: 6 months (with possibility of extension)

Hours: 40 hours per week


Overview

We are seeking an experienced Regulatory Research Analyst to join the Tax & Regulations team of a global independent support provider. This fully remote role focuses on researching and tracking global trade regulations —primarily across LATAM and North America—and contributing insights that help keep SAP GTS systems up to date for global clients. The analyst will act as the first point of contact for new legal and regulatory changes and work closely with Business Analysts and ERP/GTS specialists. Client interaction is minimal; the role is primarily research-oriented.


Key Responsibilities

Regulatory Research & Analysis

  • Monitor and maintain up-to-date awareness of legislative and regulatory changes in assigned countries using government websites, agencies, third-party sources, and in-country experts.
  • Track global trade compliance regulations, including customs duties, export controls, sanctions, tariff updates , and other relevant requirements across jurisdictions (U.S., Canada, LATAM, etc.).
  • Interpret, analyze, and document new or amended legislation in an internal repository with high accuracy and clarity.
  • Prepare comparative analyses of regulatory changes when required.
  • Ensure research and documentation meet ISO process standards .

SAP GTS Alignment

Research and provide insights relevant to SAP GTS (v11 or similar), supporting product specialists on topics such as:

  • Export Control & Licensing
  • Import Control & Market Access
  • Sanctions & Restricted Party Compliance
  • Customs & Tariff Management
  • Trade Agreements & Origin Management
  • Regulatory Reporting & Declarations
  • Product & Classification Compliance

Collaboration & Documentation

  • Deliver clear summaries and detailed regulatory insights needed by ERP and product specialists to implement system changes for clients.
  • Collaborate with Business Analysts and fellow researchers to validate findings and maintain consistency.
  • Support research expansion into Indirect Tax topics (VAT, GST, country-specific filing requirements) where applicable.


Must-Have Qualifications

  • Bilingual: English + one LATAM language (Spanish or Portuguese) .
  • 5+ years of professional experience in tax, global trade, or international regulatory research.
  • Working knowledge of SAP GTS or similar trade compliance systems.
  • Familiarity with international trade laws and frameworks (EAR, ITAR, EU Dual Use, WCO, etc.).
  • Strong research, analytical, and documentation skills with excellent attention to detail.


Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and handle multiple tasks under pressure.
  • Strong internet-based research capabilities and proficiency in business applications (Microsoft Office, Google tools, SharePoint, etc.).
  • Experience compiling complex regulatory information into clear, actionable summaries.
  • Technical understanding of SAP ERP tax/accounting workflows (advantageous, not mandatory).
  • Familiarity with tools like Excel, PDF generation, ABBYY FineReader, Deepl, Inoreader, Beyond Compare (training provided).
  • Self-starter with strong initiative, resourcefulness, and team-oriented mindset.
  • Additional background in finance or tax is a plus.


Why Join Us?

  • Work remotely while contributing to high-impact global compliance research.
  • Collaborate with a diverse international team of trade and tax experts.
  • Play a key role in helping global clients stay compliant with rapidly evolving regulations.

title: Anaplan Model Builder
description:
Job Title: Experienced Anaplan Model Builder (FP&A & Data Integration)

Nice to have skills: FP&A knowledge or certification, Anaplan Data Integration using Anaplan API or other tools.

Role Overview

We are seeking an Experienced Anaplan Model Builder with strong FP&A and data integration experience. The candidate will work closely with the Technical Manager, PDM (Product Development Manager), and directly with business stakeholders to deliver scalable Anaplan solutions and support ongoing operations.

Responsibilities

  • Build and enhance Anaplan models for budgeting, forecasting, and reporting.
  • Collaborate with the Technical Manager, PDM, and business teams to translate requirements into model designs.
  • Develop modules, dashboards, and UX pages following best practices.
  • Manage data integrations using Anaplan Connect, CloudWorks, Informatica, MuleSoft, etc.
  • Support existing Anaplan applications, including production support, issue resolution, and enhancements.
  • Ensure data accuracy, maintain documentation, and assist with troubleshooting.
  • Support user onboarding, training, and continuous process improvement.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years Anaplan model-building experience; Anaplan Model Builder certification required.
  • Strong FP&A knowledge (budgeting, forecasting, financial modeling).
  • Experience integrating Anaplan with ERP/CRM/data systems.
  • Excellent analytical and communication skills for direct business interaction.
  • Nice to have: Java or Python for API integrations with Anaplan; experience with SAP/Oracle/NetSuite/Workday, SQL, or ETL tools.
